dimensions.note: apiToken is meta({sensitive:true}) and documented as vault-only. vreq never includes the token in thrown errors or logs; error bodies are sliced to 300 chars of the server response. No other secret-shaped fields.
Structured info/warning logs with ids, counts and bucket names; per-move log in reorder apply; no descriptions or tokens logged.

Non-2xx throws with method+path+status. reorder throws on unknown bucket names before any write, on maxIterations, and when the final re-read is still out of order. audit throws on a project with no kanban view or no buckets rather than reporting an empty board as clean.

12 deno tests cover the pure rules: role mapping, HTML text length, every audit rule and its role-scoped severity, label groups, staleness thresholds, done-flag mismatch, sort order both tie-breaks, bucket WIP/order findings, nextMove midpoint and collapsed-gap fallback. No mocked-HTTP tests; the HTTP path was exercised live against a 55-card board (audit: 104 findings; reorder apply: 30 moves, converged, second dry run 0 moves).
audit is read-only. reorder converges to a fixed point: a re-run after apply plans zero moves. 429 retried with Retry-After up to maxRetries; per-request AbortController timeout.

Never uses POST /tasks/{id} (a full replace in Vikunja). Positions set via POST /tasks/{id}/position with project_view_id. Board read via /projects/{p}/views/{v}/tasks paginated per bucket with page size from /info and a no-growth stop, because one page silently truncates long buckets. Bucket tasks may be null; handled.
fetch bodies cancelled on retry; timers cleared in finally; page loop bounded at 100 pages; reorder bounded by maxIterations (max 500).
Archive is the model file, README and LICENSE only; the test file is not packaged. README uses vikunja.example.com; no internal hostnames, ids or vault names in packaged files.

Method args are strict zod objects with defaults and bounds (apply defaults false; maxIterations 1..500). Resource schemas use passthrough deliberately so Vikunja fields survive; the audit/plan schemas are fully typed.
boardAudit and reorderPlan are infinite lifetime with garbageCollection 30, one instance per project per run, so the datastore keeps a bounded history of audits.

This model deliberately does not update or delete tasks: POST /tasks/{id} is a full replace that has blanked descriptions before, so judgement edits stay with the calling agent doing GET, merge, POST. Scope is create, list, audit, reorder.

reorder resolves and validates every requested bucket title against the live view before the first write; new_task resolves the bucket before creating. Kanban view existence is checked first in all board methods.
task-<id>, list-<id>, summary-recent, audit-<projectId>, reorder-<projectId>: deterministic and collision-free per project.
All state is read from the Vikunja API on every run; nothing is read from the datastore or the filesystem.
